name: Unearthed Memoirs
storyline:
It's one of those nights...
You find your mind wandering to what you are...
It delves deeper and deeper like a seed buried...
What do we hope to unearth in the depths of our memoirs?
Oh I wonder what you'll find at the depths of it all...
Gather what you are to mold what you wish to be!

Delve deeper into your mind with each level and gather your memories by mining the gold and at the end face your inner-self.
summary:
A 2D platformer where you go through each level collecting what is golden to you.

Featuring 3 levels each with their own new gimmick to try and speed run through, the faster you are the more points you get!
